notes: Conditional Access now shows your named locations and authentication strengths: counts in the stat row and a new 'Infrastructure' tab listing each one read-only.
Authentication strengths show their actual allowed sign-in method combinations (e.g. Windows Hello for Business, FIDO2, certificate-based MFA) instead of an unlabelled count.
Run a backup on demand, restore any snapshot, and edit the daily/weekly schedule from Conditional Access → Backup & Restore.
